name: Vespid Dynamics Neural Disruptor ND-4 'Brainstorm'
description:
A directed electromagnetic weapon that targets the electrical activity of the human nervous system. The ND-4 fires a shaped electromagnetic pulse tuned to frequencies that interfere with neural signaling, causing immediate loss of motor control, cognitive disruption, and — at maximum power — permanent neurological damage.

Vespid developed the Brainstorm as an evolution of their non-lethal product line, but the weapon's effects at various power settings blur the line between incapacitation and brain damage. At minimum power, the ND-4 causes a 30-second loss of motor control — a target simply collapses, fully conscious but unable to move. At medium power, targets experience seizures and memory loss lasting hours to days. At maximum power, the electromagnetic pulse destroys neural pathways, causing irreversible cognitive impairment.

The weapon leaves no external marks on the target. A Brainstorm victim at maximum power appears healthy but has suffered the neurological equivalent of a massive stroke. Medical professionals have called it 'the most humane way to destroy a person without killing them.'
legality: Non-lethal classification at minimum power; Prohibited at medium/maximum
specifications:
caliber: N/A — shaped electromagnetic pulse
effective_range: 5-100 meters
rate_of_fire: 1 pulse per 3 seconds
capacity: 20 pulses per power cell
weight: 4.2 kg
power_source: Integrated EMP power cell, field-replaceable
tactical_use: The Brainstorm is deployed for capture operations, interrogation preparation, and non-lethal engagement of high-value targets. At minimum power, the weapon is a safe and effective incapacitation tool. The danger lies in the temptation to increase power — a target who resists after a minimum-power pulse can be hit again at medium power, and an interrogator facing a stubborn subject can dial the weapon up until cooperation becomes involuntary. The ND-4's power dial has no labels, only numbers. Vespid's training manual devotes a full chapter to the ethics of power selection.
cultural_context: The Brainstorm has become a symbol of the thin line between law enforcement and cruelty in GLMZ. Rights organizations have documented cases of ND-4 use at power levels that caused permanent brain damage during what were supposed to be routine arrests. Vespid's defense — that operators are trained to use minimum power — is undermined by the weapon's design, which makes escalation as easy as turning a dial. The phrase 'brainstormed' has entered street slang to describe someone who has been neurologically damaged by authority.
story_hooks: A clinic in the lower tiers is treating a growing number of patients with identical neurological damage patterns — all were 'arrested' by the same corporate security team using ND-4s at power levels far above minimum. Someone is using the Brainstorm as a punishment tool.

A black-market operator has modified an ND-4 to fire at a frequency that specifically targets the neural architecture of BCI implants, causing the implant to overload and burn out. The modification turns a non-lethal weapon into a targeted anti-augmentation device.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular directed-energy weapon resembling a hybrid between a precision rifle and a medical diagnostic device. The silhouette is deliberately clinical — sharp lines and minimal ornamentation suggest surgical precision rather than combat brutality. The barrel assembly is unusually compact and features a distinctive honeycomb venting pattern. Overall impression: a tool of control rather than destruction.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 68 cm | Width at grip: 4.5 cm | Height (including targeting optics): 12 cm | Barrel assembly: 22 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and deceptively light at 4.2 kg — the weight sits forward in the barrel assembly where the pulse capacitors are housed, creating an intuitive aim-point feel. Handles like a precision instrument, not a bludgeon.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade carbon composite frame with reinforced polymer grip housing. Barrel assembly is brushed titanium with embedded copper coil matrices visible through semi-translucent side panels.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed titanium accents. The barrel features a distinctive satin finish with faint copper undertones from the electromagnetic coils beneath. Wear-resistant nano-coating shows minimal patina even after extended field use.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: cool gunmetal gray with black polymer accents. Secondary: brushed titanium and faint copper-gold visible through translucent barrel vents. Power indicator strips glow soft blue (minimum), amber (medium), or warning red (maximum).
physical_description.grip_texture: Soft-touch rubberized polymer with subtle non-slip ribbing. Ergonomic finger wells suggest the weapon was designed for precision trigger control rather than sustained grip strength. Slightly tacky feel aids handling in wet conditions.
distinctive_features: Honeycomb electromagnetic venting pattern along barrel (functional AND aesthetic)
Semi-translucent side panels revealing copper electromagnetic coil matrix
Integrated targeting laser (invisible IR mode available)
Unlabeled rotary power dial on the receiver (1-10 scale, intentionally obscured)
Pulsing blue status LED on the top rail (indicates charge state and thermal load)
Capacitor charging whine audible during power-up (tactical warning)
No visible magazine or ammunition feed — entirely self-contained
Precision alignment crosshairs etched into the top rail
Recessed impact dimples on the polymer body (durability reinforcement)
Field-replaceable power cell slot with magnetic latch on the left side
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS logo (stylized wasp silhouette) stamped in recessed relief on the left side of the receiver. Serial plate below the logo features microscopic text. ND-4 variant identifier laser-etched into the top rail. No product name — Vespid leaves that to the street.
physical_description.condition_typical: Meticulously maintained in corporate hands; shows minimal wear. In field use among Tier 4 operatives, exhibits light scuffing on the polymer and faint discoloration from repeated capacitor thermal cycling. Rarely heavily damaged — the weapon's non-kinetic nature means it survives encounters intact.
